description: Explicit type argument for state whose initial value does not cover every case: `useState<User | null>(null)`, `useState<Todo[]>([])`.
DOM ref typed with the element type, read with optional chaining.
React synthetic event types, generic over the element: `ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>`. `FormEvent` is deprecated in the latest types.
Union of object types sharing a literal `type` field. `switch (action.type)` narrows each member.
Assigning the value to `never` in `default` makes unhandled union members a compile error.
